title.narrative: Building Effective Health Systems for Malaria Control

description.narrative: Ghana - Malaria - AngloGold Ashanti (Ghana) Malaria Control Limited - AGAMal. This program has the following goals: Reduce the malaria mortality by 90% by the year 2025 (using 2019 as baseline). Reduce malaria case incidence by 50% by 2025 compared with 2019 baseline. Achieve malaria pre-elimination in at least 6 districts by 2025. The objectives of this program are: To protect at least 90% of the population with effective malaria prevention interventions by 2025. Provide appropriate diagnosis to all suspected malaria cases and prompt and effective treatment to 100% of confirmed malaria cases in accordance to treatment guidelines by 2025. Ensure timely and adequate supply of quality-assured malaria commodities to all service delivery points by 2025. Increase awareness and knowledge of the entire population on malaria prevention and control so as to improve uptake and correct use of all interventions by 2025. Strengthen and maintain capacity for Governance and programme management to achieve programmatic objectives at all levels towards malaria control and pre-elimination by 2025. Strengthen malaria surveillance and M&E system to ensure timely availability of high quality, consistent malaria data at all levels including private sector, to track the progress of malaria interventions towards the 2025 malaria control targets. Improve finance and resource mobilization
